title: Magnetic radius formula
description: Essential: Correctly states the radius formula R = mv/(qB) with the correct velocity at point A.

title: Velocity at point A
description: Important: Applies the geometry of the entry angle (60°) to relate the velocity at A (v) to the initial velocity v0, finding v = 2v0 or equivalent.

title: Final radius answer
description: Essential: Derives and presents the final numerical answer for part (1): R = 2mv₀/(qB).

title: OA distance calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the horizontal distance OA using kinematics in region I, involving acceleration a = qE/m and time t₁ derived from the vertical velocity component.

title: AP distance geometry
description: Important: Uses the geometry of the circular arc in region II (60° chord/segment) to find the horizontal distance AP, relating it to the radius R.

title: Final OP width answer
description: Essential: Correctly sums OA and AP to give the final expression for part (2): x_OP = (√3 m v₀/q)(v₀/E + 1/B).

title: Time in each region
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time spent in region I (t₁), region II (t₂ = (πm)/(3qB) for 60° arc), and region III (t₃ until v=0).

title: Acceleration in region III
description: Important: Identifies the correct acceleration in region III as a' = qE/(2m), opposing the horizontal motion.

title: Final total time answer
description: Essential: Correctly sums t₁, t₂, and t₃ to give the final expression for part (3): t = ((√3+4)mv₀)/(qE) + (πm)/(3qB).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the charge (q) in force equations, or misidentifies the direction of acceleration/deceleration in any region.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the 60° entry angle (e.g., using sine instead of cosine for the velocity relation, or using the wrong angular fraction for the arc time).
